why: Owner report 2026-11-06: the article writer is producing hard-to-read pieces. Four classes hold a publish because they are deterministic (an executive summary at the foot of the page, a bullet carrying two statistics, two citations in one sentence, a run-on source list). The prose classes (read-twice, timeline repetition, cold closing concept) are reported to the rewrite and the reviewer and never hold: they are heuristics over grammar, and a heuristic that cannot see paraphrase must not reject an article.
